title: AXM frontier capture ledger entry
description: One captured frontier move: expensive cognition converted into a reusable artifact. Rows live in data/capture/*.jsonl with record_type 'capture' (delta observations ride in the same files under delta_observation.schema.json). scripts/validate_capture_ledger.py enforces this schema plus the closure rules a schema can't express: a capture with zero validated replays may not claim amortization, and the captured artifact must actually exist in the repo.

source_task_id.description: The task whose residue was resolved. May link to a waterline cell; linking never mutates the waterline.

cost_basis.description: Evidence class of the capture cost. Mixed-basis ROI must be labeled as such by capture_roi.py.

type.description: e.g. edge_family + routing_rule, hidden_grader, scaffold_packet, lens

old_path.description: The floor path — what replays run on once the artifact carries the judgment.

new_path.description: The frontier call being retired — what each validated replay avoids.

break_even_reuse_count.description: MEASURED break-even only — stays null until validated replays exist. Projections are computed by capture_roi.py at read time, never stored as fact.

validated_replays.description: Count of hidden-graded solves that used the captured artifact on the floor path instead of a frontier call. Zero until the replay protocol runs.

replay_evidence.description: Ledger rows / evidence layers backing validated_replays. Required non-empty when validated_replays > 0.

waterline_effect.description: Narrative of how the waterline moved. Descriptive only — this ledger never writes waterline.json.

status.description: amortized is the ONLY closed state and requires validated_replays >= measured break-even with replay_evidence. Everything else is explicitly non-closed (burden-discipline failure default).

burden.description: The closure packet (docs/burden-discipline.md): who owes proof, who may close, what happens when proof is missing.

gap.description: What remains missing/disputed/partial/unmeasured. 'none' only when truly closed.
